definitions.gloss: Cup Noodle, instant noodles in a cup
definitions.explanation: Instant noodles sold in a cup by the food company Nissin since 1971. Hot water is poured in and the noodles are ready in three minutes. It is a brand name, but many people use it loosely for any cup noodles.

examples.english: I had Cup Noodle for lunch.

notes:
Created by {安藤百福|あんどうももふく}, the founder of Nissin ({日清食品|にっしんしょくひん}), who had earlier invented instant ramen. It is one of the most famous Japanese food products worldwide.
